note: FIX item A in fix commit bf62771b (consolidated-round-3.md)
summary: r3 F2 ccr[0]: internal/complete/panel_deferred.go `recheckResumedPanelDeferrals` (round-2 fix, resume path): when a refutation supersedes a durable deferral inside the crash window, the function narrows only its own live check (`group = needed`) and persists the refutation as pending (`persistPendingEntries(beadID, applied)`), but never rewrites `deferral_pending_entries` (the non-resume path does: `persistDeferralPending` keeps 'only this run's checked entries'). Step 3.75 `reconcilePendingDeferrals` then writes `"panel_deferred_entries": unionDeferrals(existing, pending)`, so the superseded deferral lands in the bead's audit. `impl approve`'s bead-panel leg (`implPanelDeferralPreflight` -> `CheckAuditedPanelDeferrals`, audited=true) re-checks that audit against live bd, the follow-up is closed, and it blocks with recovery `bd reopen '<follow-up>'` only; per R10.2 a later `panel refute` cannot clear it. This contradicts R10.1 ('holds the effective deferrals of each Allowed registration') and the resume's own printed recovery ('or mindspec panel refute ...'), which leads the operator into a later impl-approve block. Proven: probe test <scratch>/spec-130-final-F2-r3/quarantine/probe-resume/internal/complete/zz_probe_f2r3_test.go (TestProbeF2R3_ResumeRefutedDeferralStaysOutOfAudit) goes red: 'SEAM: the refutation-superseded deferral landed in panel_deferred_entries' and 'SEAM: impl approve bead-panel leg would BLOCK ... recovery: bd reopen' while the control shows 'live EffectiveDeferrals=0 AppliedRefutations=1'. Fix: in `recheckResumedPanelDeferrals`, after filtering every group, persist the still-effective set with `persistDeferralPending(beadID, <needed across all groups>)` (and, because the bead is not yet closed, also remove the superseded entries from `panel_deferred_entries` if an earlier attempt already wrote them), and extend `TestComplete_ResumeRechecksDurableDeferrals` subtest `refuted` to assert that `panel_deferred_entries` holds no entry for the refuted finding and that `CheckAuditedPanelDeferrals(reg, entries)` returns nil (today that subtest asserts only `result.BeadClosed` and `panel_refuted_entries`).

summary: r4 F1 ccr[0]: impl approve: an audited bead-panel deferral is skipped when no non-abandoned registration carries its (spec, panel) identity, and the identity is only the directory basename. Reproduced at bf62771b (probe <scratch>/spec-130-final-F1-r4/quarantine/staging/f1r4_probe2_test.go, run in a copy of HEAD): a bead panel 'deferred' with a deferral audited by complete; follow-up bead closed; implPanelDeferralPreflight blocks with 'bd reopen'. Then `mv review/deferred review/deferred-renamed` (no verb) and run the Core-3 recovery the message itself names, `mindspec panel tally deferred-renamed` (probe: panel.WriteCoverageManifest(panel.Tally(renamed)); the CLI verb does the same, see <scratch>/spec-130-final-F1-r4/attack-5.log and the 'panel':'p2x' manifest it appended to the p2 ledger). After that implPanelCore3Preflight=nil and implPanelDeferralPreflight=nil: impl approve passes with a closed follow-up. The same probe at the pre-fix commit 2bbc5482 still blocks ('follow-up bead must exist and be open') after rename and after rename+tally, so the round-3 scope predicate `(entry.Spec == "" && entry.Panel == "") || (entry.Spec == reg.Panel.Spec && entry.Panel == reg.Slug())` in internal/approve/impl.go (implPanelDeferralPreflight, ~line 1328) regressed AC-23 ('On a bead panel, a bead closed after complete blocks impl approve'; the only skip is 'A deferral on an abandoned panel is not checked'). CheckHandEdits does not cover the ledger 'panel' name vs the directory basename, so the rename is a hand edit R5.3 misses, and the tally verb then legitimises the new slug in the manifest. Required: an effective audit entry must be re-checked unless the registration it names exists and is verb-backed abandoned (after the R11.5 legacy-marker and R5.3 checks, as now). Concretely, invert the predicate: skip an entry only when a scanned registration with (reg.Panel.Spec, reg.Slug()) == (entry.Spec, entry.Panel) is abandoned; check every other identified entry once (through its own registration, or with no registration at all, naming entry.Panel in the message), and keep the no-identity (legacy) clause as it is.
